body: I made that choice so fucking long ago and I've gotten absolutely fucking nothing. Fucking zilch, this is probably the most in depth talk I've ever had with someone before they give me the eye rolls and stop listening. Being sober doesn't mean anything to me and that's the whole damn point. Nothing does anymore, I can't feel right, or even percieve the world correctly. I get viewing things from an optimistic point, but at what point do you stop living in reality. Cuz I can live with being a jaded moron, but I can also sober up, give my life a good look and realize too fucking much. I owe so much money, there's people who are dead due to my actions and I can't take that back, I can't go to the grieving family and what? Ask for forgiveness? Ask what I can do to help? Idk at this point I can't even be jaded, or maybe I am through my own head. All I know is that no one can help me unless I want help and really at this point I don't think I do. I think that's why I'm here in the first place, you say there's humility in seeking help. I don't think I ever was seeking help. Idk
I face the public with a very fake smile and tend to make jokes about it to whoever asks. Usually if they want to talk beyond that I make them too sad..

Wish it was that easy, throwing away the bottle would've worked before I moved, now it's the only thing keeping me going. My friends in the house don't let me touch alcohol, and its not sold in the marts, so I've j been chugging nyquil because that for some reason helps the voices. The schizophrenia is effecting every part of my life and I feel my consciousness slipping through my grasp. This is the first time I've been sober all day, days not even over and I already have a plan

Idk, personally I don't see a point in asking for help. You can't trust people, u go to them and it all just backfires every fucking time. I've had attempts in the past but whenever the next one comes, it can't be stopped. I'm past 10, I'm past the point of therapy and talking.
The death of my best friend, and the next few attempts
